reuse.why: No shared category selector exists in this tree, and the change does not introduce one: it pastes the same SQL filter, income/tracking check and sign flip the other month-wide actions carry.

duplication.why: The category query (tombstone/hidden/group hidden/goal_def) and the income-in-tracking skip are a fifth copy of the blocks in setZero and the average actions, and the sign inversion repeats set3MonthAvg's.

placement.why: Action is in budget/actions.ts and registered in budget/app.ts with mutator(undoable(...)) beside the other month-wide methods.

scope.why: Only the new action, its registration and a test.

maintainability.why: Any future change to which categories month-wide actions fill must now be repeated in one more place.

bypasses_abstraction.where: No shared selection abstraction exists in the tree to bypass.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied query and income check are verbatim, not reshaped.
